name: minimap_fade
_comment: Wave 10 item 7: the `h` minimap's fade and clicks on its hidden area long after it hid. Pilot w2_map at Map Hub (the minimap is the 208x206 box at window 414,151, centred on the hub at 1.77 px/unit: NE at 562,178, SW at 430,342, WSW at 468,236, East at 589,254). h, then clicks on alternating neighbours: near the end of the peek, then about 0.5 s, 3 s, 10 s and 20 s after the previous peek has hidden (each answered click re-shows it for 2.2 s). The recording times the fade and every click; the nav panel names the pick.
